description: Functional specifications/files: Bridge/Api/JidoChatBridge/AdapterOptions, capability snapshot and existing ChannelsLive template. Suppress abort/handled-policy fallback; preserve confirmation and callbacks. Tests to add first: connector selection/default/false, unsupported strict zero effects, create/edit option propagation, successful-only confirmation and no resend, UI hide for file-only adapters. Existing behavior assertion changes require exact human approval; do not edit pending assertions. Branches text-only, default/on/off, create/update, unsupported, failure reporting. Mocking existing edge transports/config seams. Documentation final step. Action reuse: extend existing connection resolution/send/upsert/DeliveryConfirmation, no provider module in Api; no new Actions or dispatch lifecycle. E2E scope tracked separately after UX approval.
